## Result and exact basis

Workflow-final-verification, governed-final, VP1B-final-readiness-boundary: success and branch-ready for the exact basis below. The final assessment covers the complete unified-authoring initiative plus the user-authorized single-model Review and Closeout clarification. Both implementation milestones remain completed. The original seven findings are reporter-resolved; independent current Design r7, Delivery r4 and fresh final whole-change Code Review r2 report no required corrections. This is a distinct Verify, not a review save or a claim that previously assessed subjects changed automatically.

## What changed and why

The complete change delivers one design skill, independent affected-subject review, portable conditional legacy guidance, a bounded Design/System ownership migration and a safe explicitly authorized managed replacement. Behavior, realization, rationale and representative acceptance live with their owning models. The managed path verifies the intact old locked basis, preserves backups/other targets and blocks drift or incoherent partial retries rather than prescribing pre-deletion that defeats hash checks. FU-012–014 retain ownership of later consolidation; current candidate metadata does not claim publication or customer adoption.

The subsequent clarification repairs a stale consumer of those owners. Review and Closeout still described a weaker v1 reader guarantee, retaining compatible readers after rollback and Workflow-owned model conventions. Its current prose now references RF-SR-06 v2-only runtime support and Design's convention. Original extraction/adoption/mapping context is labeled historical; old bytes and approvals retain their meaning without current runtime support. All18 RC requirements,5 decisions and the independent explicit-recording-v1 document marker are byte-identical. The marker remains a document-validation identifier; renaming it is not hidden in this prose correction. No runtime, schema, skill, package, dependency or existing plan change was introduced by the refinement.

## Authority, traceability and preservation

The accepted proposal remains unchanged. Current Design Review r7 assesses the five-model package: Design, System, Workflow, scoped Target-native init and this RC consumer clarification, against the unchanged Record Format/CLI owners and explicit user correction. Delivery Review r4 independently confirms the unchanged plan and proof allocation remain adequate; no new runtime or implementation allocation is inferred. Original M1/M2 and TG-01–07/TG-FINAL-01/02 allocations continue to cover DES/SYS/TNI and selected Workflow requirements. The RC correction applies existing RC-SR-05/06/16, RF-SR-06 and Design convention ownership without changing their policy.

The fresh final whole-change review assesses all delivered engineering and cross-milestone interactions, including the new RC subject, rather than treating previous final approval as automatically current. Original final Code Review remains stored with its original subjects. The complete previous successful Verify is preserved in evidence entry prior-verify-d62fd3fa, explicitly historical-only; this new report supplies a new assessment and immutable Git basis. The earlier extraction and retirement records remain unchanged. No old approval has been retargeted.

The reviewer and Verify inspected the archival/current contrast: historical v1 procedures and records explain past decisions, while current runtime operations reject the retired format; preservation does not justify restoring a reader. They also assessed unchanged Test/review policy, independent examples and current Design/Workflow ownership. The refinement corrects a single consumer, not all historical documents or all format names.

## Evidence and impact assessment

Actual new runs after the RC correction:

- python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --check --path docs/design/review-closeout/review-closeout.md: passed.
- python scripts/validate-documentation-prose.py --mode enforce --path docs/design/review-closeout/review-closeout.md: passed,0 errors/warnings.
- python scripts/validate-markdown-readability.py --generated-document docs/design/review-closeout/review-closeout.md docs/design/review-closeout/review-closeout.md: passed with45 paragraph-length warnings.
- Python direct comparison against d62fd3fa:18 RC-SR rows,5 RC-DEC rows and marker byte-identical; every local file link and heading anchor resolves.
- node --test packages/rigorloop/test/record-retirement.test.js:24 passed, confirming current v1 rejection and v2 behavior at the existing runtime boundaries.
- python scripts/select-validation.py --mode explicit --path docs/design/review-closeout/review-closeout.md:5 maintained checks selected, no blockers/unclassified paths and broad_smoke_required:false. Every selected command was actually run after the correction: node scripts/build-record-store-schema.mjs --check; model validation for CLI/Record Format/RC/Workflow; python scripts/test-boundary-first-validation.py; python scripts/test-change-metadata-validator.py; npm test --prefix packages/rigorloop. All passed; full Node suite454 tests and boundary suite87 tests.
- Fresh current exact-subject comparisons, review/finding/work/applicability inspection, record-store validation, git diff --check, Git base/head/merge-base and tracked-tree checks passed before recording.

Documentation, current-authority interpretation and lifecycle evidence are affected by the refinement, with direct semantic review and structural/preservation checks above. Runtime/public API, persistence, migration implementation, security primitives, dependencies, build, generated archives and external-environment assumptions are unchanged since the prior verified engineering: the actual cumulative engineering diff is only the RC Markdown consumer. Its normative requirement and decision bytes do not change, and skill projections do not consume this internal model text. Fresh Node/retirement tests corroborate retained support boundaries; no executable behavior is inferred from documentation alone.

For the complete initiative, V1–V8 and MW-01/02/03 remain applicable subject to the explicit current assessment. The prior actual355 skill,156 selector,158 adapter,38 helper, seven build and seven publication checks, source/projection validation, all-three-candidate clean installs and actual managed upgrade/interruption/recovery walkthroughs are retained. Their exact proved source/candidate/environment identities are unchanged; current checks and independent reassessment found no contradictory proof. In particular, the installed example-only/unchanged-parent review contrast, substantive legacy-format amendment with complete packaged methods, and intact-old-basis managed replacement with safe interrupted retry still have their original concrete proof. Counts identify actual runs, not test adequacy. No named negative/regression protection was removed.

The unchanged candidate archive hashes remain Codex e72b5adb11ce124613cdcfbcfa2fbeb6e8b69a33b1db732f93a44840b30f8167, Claude 8fd30c8cc7db31fba773f80d806386fd0e15ce3b3cf37d6bf400a60a801b7139 and OpenCode a84612ab469877b771f3de454a1a13dacc301a344ab546f3dce00e33d0e7b270. Earlier MW-03 test-file addition was already independently assessed; exercised code/procedure/candidate remained unchanged and the final454-test suite passed again. The fresh review is not used to refresh stale execution labels by itself.

## Limitations and external handoff

The unchanged historical Target-native init body retains13 full-file prose-wrap errors, directly baseline-compared in the original Verify and preserved evidence. New/current scoped checks pass; no full-file prose pass is claimed. Historical architecture-method marker failures were corrected with bounded immutable-retirement validation and regression tests, not waived. RC readability length warnings are nonblocking; they do not override the prose/structure passes or independent semantic assessment. The approved first-slice scope does not consolidate every remaining historical design.

Release-only V9 remains not-run under its existing explicit publication trigger; current candidate validation is complete. No merge, release, publication, customer adoption or broad format-marker migration is authorized here. Hosted CI passed for the prior PR head d62fd3fa37912c7c3fdfbfbb1e5fedb77195845a (run34278981872); that is not a CI result for this refined head. New hosted CI is unobserved until the updated PR is pushed. The user's existing continuation-through-PR authority permits the separate PR handoff after exact remote/branch and evidence-suffix checks. Preserve the existing PR body unless its replacement is separately authorized; the linked current evidence contains this refinement.
